## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 10, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _LilyCat382_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "Chai used to be a daily break. You could just chat, make stories and be creative. Today, bugs, arbitrary message limits and constant subscription notices dominate the app. Sometimes you have hundreds of messages, then suddenly 0 with no explanation. It's sad to see how an app with so much potential and a loyal community has lost so much quality. I don't want to use the app anymore, it's no use, you can't chat anymore. Please bring back the old Chai."
            2. _Hayden R._, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "the only issue is the filter😕 its so annoying when i try to make like a story or whatever n stuff, the filter just like ruins it all... i mean, the underage thing i get, but the others? nah"
            3. _Yamato Yagi_, Jul 23, 2026, 1/5: "There's a bug that doesn't let me edit messages. When I do, it instead just generates a different message over that. Fix this bug, it is nearly app-breaking."
